title: orch run record v1 (.orch/run/tickets/<ticket id>.json)
description: The claim of the one agent run working on a ticket on this machine. Gitignored, per machine, never committed. Written only under the per-ticket O_EXCL lock (.orch/run/tickets/<id>.lock): re-read, decide, write tmp + os.replace. Session ids are NOT kept here: they live in the ticket (ticket.sessions[]), which is the one store. A missing file = nobody works on the ticket here. Unknown fields are kept.

run.description: Random id of this run, new on every claim.

by.description: Who started the run: a free actor name (a person, or whatever passed --by). The core never lists the allowed values.

agent.description: Adapter name (agent-adapter.schema.json key or a [agents.<name>] entry).

mode.description: live = long-running interactive agent in tmux; oneshot = one process per turn (the fallback that always works).

socket.description: tmux -L socket name: orch-<hash of the workspace path>.

session.description: tmux session name = the ticket id.

tmux.description: Where a live run sits. null for oneshot.

pid.description: Process of the agent (or of `orch run _wrap`). null = hand-started agent that claimed by itself. A claim with a pid is stale only when that pid is gone or alive with a different start time.

pid_started.description: Start time of pid as the OS reports it; guards against pid reuse.

renewed_at.description: Last orch write by the run. Without a pid: 'maybe stale' after 30 min without one; taken over only by an explicit `orch run start --take-over`.

stop_requested.description: When someone asked the run to stop; null = nobody.

seen_revision.description: Ticket revision the running agent has seen; the 'New on <ticket> since you looked' footer (stderr only) lists what changed after it.

maybe_stale_since.description: Optional. Set when a claim without a pid passed 30 min without an orch write.

reason.description: Optional. Plain words why the run was started, e.g. 'Answer to q2'.

agent_pid.description: Optional. Process of the agent itself, set by the wrapper. The claim is alive while pid OR agent_pid is alive with its recorded start time, so a killed wrapper does not free a working agent.

agent_pid_started.description: Optional. Start time of agent_pid (pid-reuse guard).

seen_history.description: Optional. Number of history lines the running agent has seen (for the footer).

state.description: What the live agent last said: idle comes from its tool's hook or `orch run done`; input is pasted only while idle.

why.description: Optional, with attention: plain words on what the tool waits for (a screen it shows before it is up, or not up after a minute).

log.description: Optional. Log file of a oneshot run, relative to the workspace root.

takeover.description: Optional, live runs only. A person typing in the session (screen.md, take-over). While present and not expired, pending input is held (not pasted). Removed on release, after 120 s without typing, when the run ends, or when the switch goes off.
